items.title: Paquito D'Rivera — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was in love with that woman very much, and I have a kid, and they knew it. Franco was three or four years old

ctx.x: I was in love with that woman very much, and I have a kid, and they knew it. Franco was three or four years old, and I was very happily married to Anneda, this was her name. And, I had opportunity to do it, but I didn’t want to leave my wife or my son there, and they knew it. It was like having a hostage there, a couple of them. But in 1980 that thing in the Peruvian Embassy happened, 11,000 people in a patio in the Embassy, you know that was horrible. They were harassing all these people just because they want…
You went to Spain in 1980, what month was that?
